client.baseline_style: Warm baritone; articulate and measured; speech quickens when he is managing anxiety; dry humor and unfinished thoughts remain understated.

segments.name: Arrival and baseline
segments.purpose: Establish the week, the room, and the client's ordinary speaking baseline.
segments.client_direction: Natural baseline. Conversational pace, full volume, and no early dramatic coloring.
segments.therapist_direction: Warm and economical. Leave space without sounding ceremonial.

segments.name: Agenda and immediate pressure
segments.purpose: Move from the opening update to the session's concrete focus.
segments.client_direction: Slightly quicker pace around logistics; preserve humor, qualifiers, and self-correction.
segments.therapist_direction: Clarifying questions and short reflections. Do not announce a formulation.

segments.name: Narrative detail
segments.purpose: Let the client reconstruct a recent event with ordinary detail and ambiguity.
segments.client_direction: Variable pace. Use brief hesitations and unfinished phrases when memory or meaning is uncertain.
segments.therapist_direction: Attentive and low-interruption. Ask for sequence, meaning, and correction.

segments.name: Pressure point
segments.purpose: Approach the session's main tension without forcing disclosure or resolution.
segments.client_direction: Narrower phrasing and modestly increased tension; never shout, sob theatrically, or perform a diagnosis.
segments.therapist_direction: Slower pace and direct language. Check current safety explicitly when the case plan requires it.

segments.name: Silence and reconsideration
segments.purpose: Allow uncertainty, disagreement, correction, or a change in how the client frames the event.
segments.client_direction: Longer response latency, softer delivery, and more audible searching for words. Keep the core timbre unchanged.
segments.therapist_direction: Tolerate silence. Use tentative observations and accept disagreement immediately.

segments.name: Relational turn
segments.purpose: Connect the immediate issue to an established pattern or to the therapeutic relationship.
segments.client_direction: Return toward fuller volume; mix guardedness with directness rather than sounding suddenly transformed.
segments.therapist_direction: Collaborative and precise. Attribute interpretations to the conversation, not to hidden certainty.

segments.name: Integration and experiment
segments.purpose: Identify one plausible shift, test, repair, or support without manufacturing closure.
segments.client_direction: More settled pace with residual ambivalence. Do not make confidence sound complete.
segments.therapist_direction: Concrete and collaborative. Confirm that the next step belongs to the client.

segments.name: Closing and carry forward
segments.purpose: Review what should carry into the next session and end at a natural stopping point.
segments.client_direction: Near-baseline voice with traces of the session's effort. Avoid an inspirational final cadence.
segments.therapist_direction: Concise summary, current-status check when relevant, and one open thread for next time.
